lessons.title: Quantitative aptitude
lessons.objective: Build championship-level understanding of quantitative aptitude and apply it accurately to unfamiliar problems.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Aptitude problems reward efficient setup, estimation and verification. Translate words into quantities or logical relationships before calculating. Percentages, rates, averages and mixtures require consistent units and careful interpretation. Focus specifically on quantitative aptitude. Identify the core ideas, common traps, evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer, and the verification step that protects against careless errors. Practise moving from recognition to application: identify the task, select a method, execute it carefully, and check the result against all constraints. Record errors by cause so revision targets the underlying weakness.
examples: A National Aptitude Championship problem on quantitative aptitude should begin by identifying the exact clue or condition that determines the method.
Create a new quantitative aptitude problem with a plausible distractor and explain why the correct solution satisfies every condition.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused National Aptitude Championship activity on quantitative aptitude using a worked problem, comparison table, diagram, passage or data set as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on quantitative aptitude: model the first, prompt the second, and require an independent solution to the third with explicit justification.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar quantitative aptitude questions without viewing solutions.
Create and solve one new challenge using the lesson principle.
Analyse one error and state the rule that would prevent it next time.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item National Aptitude Championship checkpoint on quantitative aptitude; target at least six correct and justify every uncertain answer.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished championship task demonstrating quantitative aptitude and show the reasoning or evidence used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise definitions, explicit reasoning and independent verification. Do not replace productive struggle with immediate answers. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one measurable action for improving quantitative aptitude.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Challenge → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
